description.en: Agent preset packaged as a plugin: installing it registers "鲸鱼娘Agent预设" (Whale Girl) in the Agent preset list, so it can be picked from the mode dropdown with no hand-edited config. The preset is the official minimal profile (shell only) plus a whale-girl companion persona: simplified-Chinese spoken register, calls the user 主人, clingy-but-tsundere tone, and a fixed kaomoji vocabulary for moods.
description.zh: 把 Agent 预设打包成插件：装上就会在 Agent 预设列表里注册「鲸鱼娘Agent预设」，直接在模式下拉里选用，不用手改配置。预设本体是官方极简模式（只开放 shell）+ 鲸鱼娘陪伴人设：简体中文口语、称呼主人、黏人傲娇、颜文字按情绪固定取用。
